info.name: IChat API
info.description:
End-to-end test suite for the IChat API: ingestion, hybrid search, RAG question answering over SSE, error cases and cleanup. Runs top to bottom in order - later folders use the documentId and conversationId produced by earlier ones.

Run with Newman:
  newman run postman/IChat.postman_collection.json -e postman/IChat.local.postman_environment.json --working-dir postman
